purpose: Define shopping-list items as explicit planning records with desired product/need semantics independent from merchant SKU, recommendation result or purchased item identity.

topics.name: Shopping Item Identity
topics.purpose: Define shopping-list items as explicit planning records with desired product/need semantics independent from merchant SKU, recommendation result or purchased item identity.

semantics.identity_rule: Each shopping item has its own explicit identity within/global to #SHOP according to owning profile.
semantics.need_rule: Item may represent a generic need/product concept without requiring merchant-specific SKU.
semantics.product_rule: Merchant product/SKU refs are optional external candidate bindings.
semantics.notes_rule: Human notes/preferences remain descriptive data and not executable procurement instructions.
semantics.recommendation_rule: Recommended candidate products do not replace shopping-item identity.
semantics.history_rule: Changing candidate/product binding does not rewrite prior item history silently.

invariants.rule: Shopping-list data expresses planning intent only; list/item existence, ranking, recommendation or selection never authorizes purchase, payment or external order execution.

hard_gates.condition: merchant SKU becomes shopping-item identity automatically
obtained state inferred solely from cart placement

references.purpose: Items belong to explicit shopping lists.

prose.summary: Define shopping-list items as explicit planning records with desired product/need semantics independent from merchant SKU, recommendation result or purchased item identity.
